app.name: Xero
app.description: Cloud-based accounting software for small businesses and their advisors.

notes: Composio manages token refreshing automatically once valid custom OAuth credentials are provided.
Ensure all default scopes (`openid`, `profile`, `email`, `offline_access`, and required accounting scopes) are included in your custom configuration.
No extra connection fields are required beyond standard OAuth parameters for the Xero toolkit.

assumption: An AI agent that reads and manages accounting records, invoices, and contacts across multiple customer Xero accounts.

verdict.headline: Xero provides a self-serve developer portal with tiered subscription pricing and mandatory certification for broader publishing.
verdict.summary: Developers can immediately register an app and test connections via the Xero Developer Centre. Moving beyond starter tiers or publishing to the Xero App Store requires paid pricing tiers, onboarding at least 10 beta customers, implementing full OAuth flows, and completing annual security assessments.

handsOnEffort.label: 2–4 days
handsOnEffort.basis: App creation and PKCE flow integration take a few hours, while gathering 10 beta customers and completing security reviews takes days.

timeToFirstConnection.label: 30–60 min
timeToFirstConnection.basis: Account creation at the Xero Developer Centre allows instant credential generation and testing.

timeToProduction.label: 2–4 weeks
timeToProduction.basis: Onboarding 10 active beta customers and undergoing certification reviews dictates the production timeline.

verdict.longestPole: Onboarding the required 10 active beta customers and completing initial security assessments for app certification.
verdict.costDetail: Starter tier is 5 connections and free. Core tier is 50 connections at $35 AUD/month, Plus is $245 AUD/month, Advanced is $1,445 AUD/month, and Enterprise has custom pricing.

easierPaths.condition: Internal custom integrations or personal usage
easierPaths.effect: Avoids App Store certification requirements and higher tiered fees.

factors.detail: Developers can sign up at xero.com and create an app instantly in the Xero Developer Centre.
Publishing to the Xero App Store and moving past Starter/Core tiers requires app certification and security assessments.
Developer partner registration requires organizational details and business verification for certification.
Certified app partners must complete initial and annual security assessments.
Core tier costs $35 AUD/month, Plus costs $245 AUD/month, and Advanced costs $1,445 AUD/month.
Apps can be registered and developed via self-service without sales intervention.
Starter tier is strictly capped at 5 connections until payment details and higher plans are adopted.
Standard OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant handles user connection flows dynamically.

phases.title: Register Developer Account and App
phases.outcome: A registered application with a Client ID and Client Secret in the Xero Developer Centre.

steps.title: Create a Xero Developer Account
steps.details: Go to **developer.xero.com** and sign up or log in with your Xero account credentials.

steps.title: Create a New App
steps.details: In the **Xero Developer Centre**, click **New app**. Enter your app name, select **Web app** as the integration type, and provide the absolute redirect URI: `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback`.
steps.agentAssist: Draft the app name and configuration parameters.

steps.title: Generate Client Secrets
steps.details: Navigate to **Configuration** for your newly created app, click **Generate a secret**, and securely copy both your **Client ID** and **Client Secret**.

phases.title: Configure Scopes and Security
phases.outcome: App configured with PKCE support and necessary granular scopes.

steps.title: Configure Granular Scopes
steps.details: Select the required scopes for your integration. Ensure you include `openid`, `profile`, `email`, `offline_access`, and granular accounting scopes like `accounting.invoices` and `accounting.contacts`.
steps.agentAssist: Generate the full scope string required for your specific workflow.

steps.title: Verify PKCE Requirement
steps.details: Ensure your auth implementation utilizes PKCE with `code_challenge_method=S256` as required by Xero's OAuth 2.0 implementation.
steps.agentAssist: Validate the authorization code request structure for `S256` compliance.

phases.title: Test with Own Account
phases.outcome: Successful OAuth token exchange and API verification using a test Xero organization.

steps.title: Initiate Authorization Flow
steps.details: Direct your browser to the Xero authorization endpoint with your Client ID and redirect URI to authorize access to your test tenant: `https://login.xero.com/identity/connect/authorize`.
steps.agentAssist: Construct the authorization URL with all required parameters and scopes.

steps.title: Exchange Code for Tokens
steps.details: Exchange the returned authorization code via POST request at `https://identity.xero.com/connect/token` to obtain your 30-minute access token and 60-day refresh token.
steps.agentAssist: Write a script to test token exchange and validation against Xero APIs.

phases.title: Prepare for Review and Certification
phases.outcome: Beta testing complete and security requirements satisfied for production app store listing.

steps.title: Onboard Beta Customers
steps.details: Onboard at least 10 active beta customers using non-demo companies to meet Xero App Store certification prerequisites.
steps.agentAssist: Draft customer onboarding scripts and instructions.

steps.title: Complete Security Assessment
steps.details: Complete the initial security assessment questionnaire and submit necessary documentation via the Xero developer portal.
steps.agentAssist: Compile security architecture notes and data handling policies.

phases.title: Go live in Composio
phases.outcome: Xero fully integrated into Composio for execution by AI agents.

steps.title: Create Custom Auth Config in Composio
steps.details: In your Composio dashboard, navigate to **Custom Auth** or **Toolkits → Xero**, and create a new custom auth configuration.
steps.agentAssist: Prepare the payload with your Client ID and Client Secret.

steps.title: Input Credentials and Scopes
steps.details: Paste your **Client ID**, **Client Secret**, and ensure the redirect URI `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback` along with your required scopes are added.
steps.agentAssist: Verify scope string compatibility with Composio default requirements.

steps.title: Initiate Connection in Composio
steps.details: Pass the custom auth config ID to your Composio session to trigger user connection flows and start managing accounting data.
steps.agentAssist: Execute API call to initiate connection link generation for end-users.

requirements.detail: Sign up at developer.xero.com to manage applications and obtain Client ID and Client Secret.
Register an absolute redirect URI (e.g., https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback) without wildcards.
Implement PKCE with S256 code challenge method during authorization code exchanges.
Onboard at least 10 active beta customers using non-demo companies to qualify for app store certification.

blockers.title: Redirect URI Mismatch
blockers.symptom: Authorization request fails with a redirect URI error or blank page.
blockers.howToProceed: Ensure the redirect URI in your Xero App settings exactly matches `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback` without wildcards or trailing slashes.

blockers.title: Connection Cap Reached on Starter Tier
blockers.symptom: API requests fail when connecting more than 5 distinct organizations.
blockers.howToProceed: Upgrade your developer plan to Core ($35 AUD/mo) or Plus to increase connection limits beyond the Starter tier cap of 5.

blockers.title: Invalid Granular Scopes Error
blockers.symptom: Authorization request rejects certain legacy scopes like `accounting.transactions`.
blockers.howToProceed: Replace broad scopes with individual granular scopes (e.g., `accounting.invoices`, `accounting.contacts`) as required by Xero's migration timeline.

nuances.title: Token Lifetimes
nuances.detail: Xero access tokens expire in 30 minutes (1800 seconds). Refresh tokens expire after 60 days of inactivity, and each successful refresh rolls the 60-day window forward.

nuances.title: AI/ML Data Training Prohibition
nuances.detail: Xero developer terms explicitly forbid using data retrieved via the Xero API to train artificial intelligence or machine learning models.

nuances.title: Rate Limits
nuances.detail: Per connection limits are 5 concurrent calls, 60 calls per minute, and 5,000 calls per day (Starter tier is capped at 1,000 calls per day). App-wide limits are 10,000 calls per minute.

nuances.title: Redirect URI Restrictions
nuances.detail: Redirect URIs must be absolute URIs without wildcards. You can register up to 50 unique redirect URIs per application.

steps: Navigate to the Composio dashboard and open the Xero toolkit settings.
Select the option to create a custom OAuth configuration.
Input your Xero Client ID and Client Secret.
Verify that the default redirect URI (`https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback`) and scopes are correctly mapped.
Save the configuration and pass the custom auth ID to your agent connection session.
